notes.title: Galactic Glitch v1.4 - Corrupted Reality Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115932/fdaa360e2184df37b8e85c1699dc2683967f82f6.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

It's that time again! The Corrupted Reality update is here! A huge update spanning all kinds of different areas of the game! This is, by far, our biggest update since 1.0, adding a new difficulty level, new weapons, new bosses, new mechanics, new story beats, more powers, more room types, and a whole new story character (you'll meet her soon...)!

We've also added features many of you have been asking for, like the Power Library in the hub where you can select which powers are active for your next run, and minion reviving, which makes those summon powers much more useful, especially in long fights against big bosses.

[h3]New Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Boss Orb 4[/b] - A new difficulty tier with an upgraded final boss encounter
[*] [b]New Mechanics:[/b] - Take in the new [spoiler]corrupted powers[/spoiler], if you dare!
[*] [b]New Character:[/b] Meet [spoiler]Symera[/spoiler] !
[*] [b]New Weapons:[/b] Three awesome new guns to unlock!
[*] [b]New Room types:[/b] Many new rooms types, like new shops and hidden rooms
[*] [b]New Music:[/b] Many areas now feature completely new music tracks
[*] [b]New Bosses:[/b] All early game areas got new bosses and variants to fight and defeat!
[*] [b]Power Library[/b] - Choose which powers appear in your runs
[*] [b]Minion Wrecks[/b] - No minion left behind! You're now able to revive fallen comrades!
[*] [b]Game Mode Selection[/b] - Select your game mode when starting new game files
[*] [b]Better progression[/b] - Guaranteed Power unlocks after won runs
[*] [b]Clearer completion[/b] - Completion marks on prototypes now clearly show what you've accomplished
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115932/d5bd94472de25e2b02ae71b37e8f4f129d3aaf82.png[/img]

[h3]Gameplay & Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Rebalanced all difficulty levels, for better progression
[*] Glitched enemy HP boost reduced for better balance
[*] Shop prices are now consistent (no more variance)
[*] Buffed various powers and weapons (Firefly, Railgun, Quantum Beam, and more)
[*] Enhanced boss health bar animations
[*] And tons of additional improvements and fixes!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115932/1a48f57f7d8996c85357164b49f597bf1460c4f0.png[/img]

This update has been months in the making, and it's all based on your feedback. Thank you so much to everyone that has been sharing their opinions and feedback on the forums and Discord!

We really hope you enjoy all the new content, and we're looking forward to hearing what you think of all the new content and changes!

Enjoy the update!
- Max and the GG team

notes.title: Galactic Glitch v1.09 - Balancing and Better Prototypes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115932/8549baceb73fd8c3992c333bbe8b96bf4c76b709.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

Thanks everyone for all your feedback on weapons and Powers! Based on it, we're now making some important balance changes, to reel in a few Powers that seemed to be just super-op (looking at you Perfect Payout). In exchange, we're also buffing a whole bunch of weapons and especially the two more advanced Prototype ships to make them a lot more interesting and fun to play!

Nox is getting a permanent poison trail, whose damage now scales with the amount of Upgrade Protocols you gather. And Frostbite's freeze ability is now a lot stronger, able to stop enemies in their tracks, even when dashing, and even stopping them from turning to aim at you!

We also buffed a bunch of weapons, and also nerfed the op Flash Spear a little bit. It's still a pretty sweet deal of a gun, but just not quite as completely bonkers-overpowered as it was before.

Here's the full changelist:

[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Buffed damage on Railgun, Arakh Double Cannon, and Stabilized Quantum Beam
[*] Buffed Quickshot damage and push, reduced slowdown
[*] Nerfed Perfect Payout (reduced doubling chances)
[*] Reworked Quick Fix power (it now doesn't block pickups, and heals correctly)
[*] Adjusted Stunning Entrance power (now does damage at higher levels, instead of stunning 4+ seconds)
[*] Reduced slowdown on Firefly Thrower
[*] Reduced Flash Spear main and special damage
[*] Prototype ship: Nox's poison trail is now way longer and scales with upgrades
[*] Prototype ship: Frostbite's freeze effect is now much stronger, and also affects enemy aim
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes and Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Nexus arrows not appearing in [spoiler]Cybervoid[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed double item spawning on shop spots
[*] Fixed SpiderWeb effect on all enemies
[*] Improved prototype switching speed
[/list]
Hope you like these changes! As always, we're listening to your feedback on how to make the game more balanced and fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115932/7ca4654e774aac78fbe8710bae4b92aec480c8c1.png[/img]

Btw, you can see which level you have beaten the game with on each of your Prototype ships. Soon, we'll be adding a new feature that let's you unlock additional stuff with each Prototype that has beaten Sim+++. So if you're looking for a challenge, why not give one of the other Prototype ships a spin?

Enjoy the game and happy glitching!
- Max and the GG team

notes.title: Galactic Glitch v1.06 - Balancing and various Improvements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115932/8549baceb73fd8c3992c333bbe8b96bf4c76b709.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

We're back with v1.06, focused on improving the Celestial District level, and balancing early and mid-late game.

For balancing, we're increasing the chance of finding Glitch Charges in shops, making the early game a bit more reliable in terms of their availability. We're also buffing the big heal items' effect, and increasing the effect of all Upgrade Protocols as you gain more. Basically, we've tuned down the diminishing returns as you gain more of each kind.

For the Celestial level, we tuned down the background brightness, to make it easier to actually see the enemies and their attacks. We've also tuned the rotation speed on some enemies, to make their tracking a bit easier to handle. We're very curious what you think of these changes and of the level as a whole!

We've also buffed some Powers and weapons, and finally fixed the Void Dagger special attack (thanks @Faust!). Red Challenges in Poisoned Reaches and The Scrapyard should also be a bit more balanced and less crazy now.

Here's the full list of changes:

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Upgrade Protocol effects degrade slower
[*] Higher chance of Glitch charges in shop
[*] Large heal pickups now restore 50% more health
[*] Reduced rotation speed on several enemies (Poisoned Reaches and Celestial District)
[*] Buffed Flash Spear damage and special attack
[*] Made some armored enemies easier to damage
[*] Buffed Void Dagger special attack and added SFX
[*] Buffed Shrapnel Explosion power
[*] Improved Celestrial Distrcict level visibility
[*] Tweaked some red challenge rooms to be more fair
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed damage display on Flash Spear
[*] Fixed damage display on Boomerang Blaster
[*] Removed distortion effect on Frostbite prototype's dodge
[/list]
We're continuing to fine-tune the balance based on your feedback. Feel free to let us know your thoughts on the game's current balance! We're always listening and happy to hear your feedback!

Happy glitching!
- Max and the GG team

notes.title: Galactic Glitch v1.05 - Fix for Black Void Bug and some Balancing
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115932/462923838ebb49d53060e935c53dbe9f42b4c058.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

It's been five days since our release, so you know what time it is - time for v1.05! We focused most our time yesterday and today on finding the save/load bug that was leaving players stuck in the black void and unable to continue. It should be fixed now for any save that had the issue, and we also made sure it doesn't happen again in the future. Sorry to anyone that had the issue, and thanks for your patience and help in sending us your save files, it helped a ton!

We also took the chance to make some more balance changes based on player feedback, for example we've buffed several powers, buffed the Void Dagger special attack, and added Glitch Token drops from the mid-game big bosses to help with your power progression.

Here's the full list of changes:

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Glitch Token drops from mid-game bosses
[*] Buffed Void Dagger special attack damage
[*] Increased Static Field power damage
[*] Increased Sonic Boom range
[*] Reward rooms in late-midgame are no longer hidden
[*] [spoiler]Hidden rooms[/spoiler] now always spawn connected to small rooms
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the save/load bug causing players to be stuck in void
[*] Fixed power sacrifice not being saved correctly
[*] Fixed power list UI being too short when having 7 powers
[/list]
[h3]Known Issues (will be fixed next week)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Glitch bomb button binding gets reset on each restart
[*] Overheal from Glitchspace healing is not loaded correctly from mid-run saves
[/list]
We hope everyone is enjoying the game now that the balance is in a better place! We want to thank everyone again for their patience, feedback, and support during these first few days of rough balance. We hope the wait was worth it!

[h3]One Last Thing[/h3]
If you're enjoying Galactic Glitch and want to support our continued development, we'd really appreciate a review! It helps the game tremendously and motivates the team to keep improving. Thanks to everyone who has already reviewed. We really appreciate it! <3

Happy glitching!
- Max and the GG team

notes.title: Galactic Glitch v1.04 - Fixing the Difficulty #2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115932/8549baceb73fd8c3992c333bbe8b96bf4c76b709.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

It's been just half a day since our last update, but we've been listening closely to your feedback and realized the balance in the later levels is still not quite right. We've decided to remove the occurrence of elite enemies in those levels entirely now, and also made many more significant changes to make the difficulty progression more appropriate. 

We're increasing the availability of healing, by doubling the health buff you get from the Glitchspace recharge station, by adding more crates in later levels, and by guaranteeing at least one heal item per Shop, and at least one shop per level. Corrupted teleporters rewards have also been significantly upped, so it should now be much more worth the risk to take one. 

Here is the full list of changes:

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed elite enemies on later levels of Boss Orb 1
[*] Reduced their spawn rates on Boss Orb 2
[*] Increased health from Recharge Stations in Glitchspace
[*] All shops now have one guaranteed healing item
[*] Improved rewards from corrupted teleport rooms
[*] Increased crate spawn rates in later levels
[*] Buffed Hurricane and Poison Dodge powers
[*] Reduced size of sectors in Quarantine level
[*] Increased minimum damage bonus from red Upgrade Protocols
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Void Dagger DPS display (it was showing 4x the real amount)
[/list]
We're always listening to your feedback, and it's helping us make the game better with every update. Please let us know what you think of these difficulty changes or any other feedback you have, it all helps a ton!

Thank you so much for your patience as we fine-tune the balance. We know it can be frustrating when the difficulty isn't quite right, and so we'll keep doing our best to get as close as possible to that sweet spot!

Have fun and happy glitching!
- Max and the GG team

notes.title: Galactic Glitch v1.03 - Fixing the Difficulty
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115932/8549baceb73fd8c3992c333bbe8b96bf4c76b709.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

We've been listening closely to all your feedback since the 1.0 launch, and one thing has come through loud and clear: the difficulty scaling is too punishing and the game becomes frustrating. We hear you!

We are reducing enemy health and damage for all later levels, and are also reducing the scaling effects for all higher Boss Orbs. This will mosly affect the later levels of the run (past [spoiler]Behemoth Boss[/spoiler]), but can also be noticeable before. We've increased the Crate spawn rate and we also doubled the HP on Crates, so they don't get destroyed so easily in the chaos of the later zones.

Besides this, there are some smaller balance changes that will hopefully make runs more balanced and fun. We've added more opportunities for gaining Upgrades Protocols, as well as healing items. We're also buffing all prototypes: All ships now get one Power Slot more, as well as a minimum 5 hp bonus from green UPs (even the back-stabby Ravager). Speaking of our backstabby buddy, we now gave him an additional speed buff as well, so he should be much more playable now.

Here is the full list of changes:

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced enemy damage in later levels
[*] Reduced enemy base health on later levels
[*] Reduced enemy health bonus by Boss Orb level
[*] Doubled Crates hitpoints
[*] Added health drop from red challenges
[*] Increased power slots on all Prototypes
[*] Added speed buff to Backstabber prototype
[*] Added reward for beating optional Mini-Boss
[*] Increased reward rooms in later levels
[*] Higher crate spawn rate in later levels
[*] Slightly buffed invincibility time after taking damage
[*] Green Upgrades bonus power now give faster special charge rate
[*] Increased minimum hp bonus from green Upgrades
[*] Special energy drains slower after inactivity
[*] Added more upgrades in Roguelite mode
[*] Shield Overload power buffed
[*] Deployable Shield now works on familiars
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Glitch Wall sometimes not unlocking when bombed
[*] Fixed various issues with [spoiler]Sentinel[/spoiler] boss
[*] Fixed [spoiler]Cerberus[/spoiler] boss colliders
[*] Fixed QuickFix power upgrade display
[*] Various other minor fixes
[/list]

We hope you'll find this version a lot more enjoyable, especially in the later stages of your runs. We want Galactic Glitch to be challenging but fair, and we hope these changes bring us closer to that sweet spot. We're very curious to hear what you guys think, so please feel free to share your thoughts.

We also put together this starter guide for the game, with lots of useful tips and tricks for players getting started with GG:

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3493806313

Thank you all again for your feedback so far. You're helping us make the game better with each update!

Happy glitching!
- Max and the GG team

notes.title: Galactic Glitch v1.02 - Balance Tweaks and Fixes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115932/462923838ebb49d53060e935c53dbe9f42b4c058.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

We've been listening closely to your feedback since the 1.0 launch, and we've heard a few complaints about the intense difficulty. While the game was always intended to be a challenging experience, we do want to make sure that it's also enjoyable, even on those not so great runs.

So today's update focuses on making the game more rewarding while keeping the challenge fair. We've buffed crate hp and drops, greatly increased rewards from corrupted teleports (the ones where you take damage), and increased the chance of reward rooms throughout your runs. We've also made more powers accessible from the start of the run, to increase variety.

Here's everything that's changed in v1.02:

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Better crate drops and increased crate health
[*] Much increased rewards from corrupted teleports
[*] Higher chance to spawn reward rooms in levels
[*] Increased minimum rewards from mixed crates
[*] Buffed shotgun special attack
[*] Removed some power unlock requirements
[*] Tweaked [spoiler]Cerberus[/spoiler] boss fight for better fairness
[*] Adjusted several enemy attack patterns and difficulty
[*] Improved camera focus during [spoiler]Cerberus[/spoiler] boss fight 
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed shop rerolls not working
[*] Fixed mini-boss healthbar not appearing
[*] Fixed mini-boss blocking room progression
[*] Fixed some enemies being immune to player poison
[*] Fixed post-Behemoth glitchspace teleport not appearing
[*] Fixed various enemy behavior issues
[*] Fixed [spoiler]Cybervoid[/spoiler] name not showing in Hub Map
[*] Fixed enemy grenades doing damage when destroyed by player
[/list]

We'd love to hear what you think about the balance of the game. We will keep actively listening and balancing the game to make sure it's always a fair challenging yet fair experience. Keep the feedback coming!

[h3]One Last Thing[/h3]
If you're enjoying Galactic Glitch, leaving a review would help us out tremendously! Reviews are super important for Steam's algorithm and help other players find the game. We read every single one and would be incredibly thankful if you could share your thoughts!

Happy glitching!
- Max and the GG team

notes.title: Galactic Glitch 1.0 Timeline Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We wanted to give you a quick update on our plans for the full 1.0 release of Galactic Glitch, which is coming in about one month from now!

First off, we want to say thanks to all of you for making our Early Access journey so awesome. We're super happy with our over [b]200 reviews and 91% positive[/b] rating! The EA period has been great for getting tons of feedback that helped us improve the game even further. You guys are the best!

We're adding a lot of new things in 1.0, starting with lots new content to deepen the experience:
[list]
[*]New levels with unique mechanics
[*]More enemies and bosses to challenge your wits and skill
[*]More weapons with different attack styles to build up your arsenal
[*]More Powers to create your own customized and crazy powerful builds
[*]A completely revamped and updated HUD
[/list]
We're also rebalancing the game's difficulty and progression completely, with a much stronger focus on Roguelike fans, who enjoy a deeper challenge. In exchange for upping the difficulty we've also increased some options of creating awesome builds, meaning that you'll need to think and plan to craft a truly powerful build. And you'll definitely need it to succeed in your goal, of escaping the simulation!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115932/6f5519ce40e192547256b49f13aec639d72672d3.png[/img]
Besides the new content and updated progression, there will also be completely new features and mechanics in the game. One of those new feature is actually one that many EA players have been asking for: [b]Unique starter ships![/b] 

The way it works: You'll be able to find and capture many wild and abandoned prototype ships which Siren created in the past, on her previous escape attempts. Once captured and returned to the Hub, you'll be able to tame and control them, and then swap them in as your own. Each of these prototypes will have unique stats and characteristics and will make for very different runs.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115932/e7fa53e3b01ae13044f232fe5e1ab90ddc6e586d.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115932/e7fa53e3b01ae13044f232fe5e1ab90ddc6e586d.gif[/img][/url]

We think these new starter ships will be an awesome addition to the game, and will offer you many new and exciting ways to plan and execute your builds on each run!

Now on to some orga stuff:

[h3]Beta Phase[/h3]
We're planning a [b]beta phase about a week before release[/b] (so in about 3 weeks from now), which will be available to all EA players. This is your chance to jump into the new content early and try out all the new goodies the game has to offer, before everyone else jumps in!

[h3]Price Update[/h3]
With the full release approaching, we'll be increasing the price of Galactic Glitch to [b]14.99 USD/EUR[/b] in the next days. If you've been thinking about jumping in, now's the perfect time to grab the game at its Early Access price!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115932/ae9029d130dde0c92082f686266373d23e6c5e9f.gif[/img]

We can't wait to show you everything we've been working on! [b]Join us on Discord[/b] or write to us on the forums with your thoughts. And if you're enjoying the game, feel free to leave a review! It helps us reach more players and grow our awesome community!

Discord: https://discord.gg/6jPYbpZa2g

Happy glitching!
The Galactic Glitch Team

notes.title: Update v.509 - Reworked Weapons System and Upgrades
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115932/a93b7cb611e5a4c345656104e33556662120a839.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

As promised in our last post, we're back with the Weapons Update! This includes a reworked weapons system based on our community's feedback that the Weapon Evolution system was not working well. You guys told us loud and clear that you preferred being able to select your preferred weapon at the start of the run again, so we listened and brough it back.

During the run, each starting weapon will be upgradable twice. These upgrades won't change the mechanics of the gun anymore, and instead only focus on improving that weapons core stats. So instead of worrying about weapon changes, this update will put the focus back on Powers and finding those perfect combinations that make each build and each run special.

We've also added the first iteration of the Weapon Blueprint system. Before unlocking new weapons in the Hub, you'll now need to gather the weapon's blueprint, which is dropped from enemies in different levels. This way, we want to avoid the feeling of rushing through all the weapon unlocks, and not having the time to get used and try each new weapon.

Here's what's new in this update:
[list]
[*] Removed the Weapon Evolution system (based on your feedback!)
[*] Added a Weapon Upgrader in Glitchspace
[*] Added back 12 starter weapons (many more coming with release)
[*] Each weapon now has 2 upgrade levels
[*] Gather Blueprints during runs to unlock them in the Workshop
[/list]
As some players requested, we've also added a dynamic camera zoom during intense combat, so you won't be hit (as often) from offscreen anymore! [i]Thanks skippydog[/i]

We want to thank you all again for the constructive feedback that led to these changes. Your input is what helps make Galactic Glitch better with each update. As always, if you encounter any issues or have thoughts about these changes, please let us know on the forums or our Discord.

Enjoy the improved weapon system, and keep glitching!

notes.title: Upcoming Weapons Update and 1.0 Release Plans
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We wanted to give you a quick update on what we're working on. Over the last few weeks, we've received lots of feedback about the Weapon Evolution system - and we heard you loud and clear! While some of you enjoyed the variety it brought, many of you mentioned that it wasn't fun to change weapons mid-run, especially when you have a favorite weapon you'd rather stick with.

To address this feedback, we decided to create a small in-between update, while we also keep working on the next big one. In this smaller update, we're actually going to remove the Weapon Evolution system that was added with the last update. Instead, we're going to replace it with a more streamlined Weapon Upgrade system, which we think will fit the game's design goals better, and will also address the feedback you've been sharing.

[h3]So what's going to change in this update?[/h3]
With this new system, we will add back the Armory and Weapon Store in the Hub. This way, you'll be able to select your preferred weapon at the start of the run again. During the run, each starting weapon will be upgradable twice. These upgrades won't change the mechanics of the gun anymore, and instead only focus on improving that weapons core stats, like less chargeup and cooldown for projectile-based weapons like the Quickshot, shorter ticks between damage and more range for beam-based weapons like the Stabilized Quantum Beam, or a larger area of effect for the Void Ring.

So instead of worrying about weapon changes, this update will put the focus back on Powers and finding those perfect combinations that make each build and each run special. 

We're aiming to have this update ready within the next week or two.

[h3]And what about the next big update?[/h3]
While we're doing this smaller update in between, we're also working on a much bigger update. In fact, our next major update will be "the big one" - our full release! This update will bring all-new levels, enemies, and bosses, and some exciting new mechanics that will give you more choice in your builds, and in how to maximize the run in the way they want. 

You'll be able to play it safe and slow, fast and furious, or anything in between. Our goal is to give you a lot more influence in how each run develops, and what combo of crazy upgraded Powers you want to smash your enemies with. We can't wait to show you all of this, and it will be coming to Steam in Q1 2025.

[h3]Early Feedback and Testing[/h3]
We're also planning to run a beta phase before the full release, in early 2025. If you're interested, sign up for our mailing list at https://www.galacticglitch.space/ and we'll reach out to you when the time comes!

Thanks again for all your feedback and support. We're looking forward to getting these weapon ugprades into your hands, and hearing what you think!

Talk to you soon, and keep glitching!

notes.title: Adding Mid-Run Saves and lots more - Update v0.130
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115932/cd5f95513a4477cb29cf910e7305f0800cc7bc40.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

It's been a few weeks since our last update, and we're back with a big one! This one includes some much requested features like mid-run saves and boost direction settings, as well as some nice gameplay improvements like much better hit feedback on enemies, and enemy rip-able parts being a lot more fun to use!

Your runs will now be saved at the start of each level, so you can take breaks during longer runs without losing progress. Boost direction now defaults to keyboard input instead of mouse, and there's a setting for it in the controls menu. Enemy hit effects are now way more noticable, and should make it much easier to see enemies' subparts, for easier targeting and ripping them clean off!

There's a ton more improvements and we've squashed a bunch of bugs too, like issues with windowed mode, players getting stuck, and weird power and enemy behaviors. Check out the full list of changes below!

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]

[/list]
[b]Balance Changes
[/b][list]
[*] General tweaking of hitboxes and hit effects, for clarity and better hit feedback
[*] General increase of enemy weapon parts firing rate when grabbed

[*] Tweak Testudo, add 2nd hitbox in rear, increase appearance on Forge level
[*] Added enemy sub-bullets doing friendly fire damage to other enemies
[*] Reduce Shocktrooper sniper projectile speed and startup time
[*] Tweak Armory wave graphs, removed Spotter as spawned enemy

[/list]

We're planning to push out a few smaller hotfixes over the next week to catch any remaining issues. After that, we'll start focusing on the next big content update, which we're planning to release in mid to late autumn.

As always, we love hearing from you! Please keep sharing your thoughts, reporting any bugs you find, and letting us know what you want to see in future updates. You can reach us on our Discord server or through the Steam forums.

Thanks for your continued support and feedback. We're only able to fix all these bugs and make these improvements because of your input, so please keep it coming!

Join us on Discord, or write to us on the forums, how you like the game and what you'd like to see in its future. And if you have a moment, feel free to leave a review! Those help massively with spreading the game to more players and growing our awesome community!
